title: Luna 16 landing site (Moon)

place.label: Mare Fecunditatis, the Moon
place.basis: Coordinates as printed in NSSDCA's Luna table; the table gives no reference frame

measures.label: Latitude and longitude on the Moon

facts.text: NSSDCA's Luna table lists Luna 16: launched 12 September 1970, landed 20 September 1970 at 05:18:00 UT, 0.68 S, 56.30 E, Mare Fecunditatis.

tiers.everyday: Luna 16 landed on the Moon on 20 September 1970 in Mare Fecunditatis. NASA lists the site at 0.68 S, 56.30 E on the Moon.
tiers.student: NSSDCA's Luna table lists Luna 16 as launched on 12 September 1970 and landed on 20 September 1970 at 05:18:00 UT, in Mare Fecunditatis, at 0.68 S, 56.30 E. The table lists it as a lunar sample return. The launch site is not on that page [UNKNOWN].

unknowns: Luna 16 launch site: not on the NSSDCA page, so [UNKNOWN]
